Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 10 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Anjali - 35 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Vikram - 38 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The classroom - a blackboard, benches

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Anjali and Vikram stand near him.]

Anjali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Kunal talks to his father on the phone.]

Kunal: "Oh wow!"

[Kunal's phone rings and he answers it.]

Vikram: "Okay, Anjali."

[Kunal types on his laptop.]

Kunal (happily): "Careful!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Anjali: "What a nice place."

[Kunal runs to Mother.]

Anjali: "Hmm, I see."

[Kunal waves goodbye to Mother.]

Kunal: "Exactly right."

[Kunal thinks for a moment.]

Kunal: "Yes, of course."

[Kunal starts crying.]

Kunal (surprised): "Oh wow!"

[Kunal pats his horse.]

Kunal (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The classroom - Day

[Kunal stands in the classroom. Anjali and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "Anjali, look over here."

[Kunal raises his hand to answer.]

Kunal: "One more time!"

[Kunal writes on the blackboard.]

Vikram: "Yes, of course."

[Kunal reads his book at his desk.]

Anjali: "Well done!"

[Kunal yawns in the class.]

Vikram (surprised): "That was such a fun day!"
